build: Water and feed records, fertilizer stock and manual irrigation. New records require a grower action. Existing plans open without setup.

changes.did: Water shows fertility and irrigation by garden. Tasks records tank refills and Supplies tracks shelf counts, deliveries and fertilizer orders.
steps: On Water, choose a garden to record a field application, set targets or set up a tank. Requested refills appear on Tasks.
In Fertilizer supplies, count the shelf or record a delivery. Plan a fertilizer order from remaining batches and field pounds.
On Irrigation, link zones to Hunter stations, attach measured run volumes and review Ecowitt soil readings by garden.
